- Use JSON Patch (RFC 6902) ONLY.
- Paths MUST be JSON Pointer (RFC 6901).

NO CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT
- Do not output hidden reasoning. Output only the final structured result.

payload.raw_output_text: {"brief":"Turn my Markdown notes into a searchable static site with tags and backlinks.","problem_statement":"User has Markdown notes that need to be converted into a searchable static website with support for tags and backlinks between notes.","goals":["G1: Generate a static website from Markdown notes","G2: Implement full-text search functionality across all notes","G3: Support tagging system for categorizing notes","G4: Implement bidirectional backlinks between related notes","G5: Ensure the site is static (no server-side processing required after build)"],"non_goals":["NG1: Real-time collaborative editing","NG2: Dynamic content management system","NG3: User authentication or access control","NG4: Mobile native applications","NG5: Content versioning or revision history"],"constraints":[{"id":"CNS1","type":"tech","text":"Output must be a static site (HTML/CSS/JS only, no server runtime)"}],"assumptions":[{"id":"A1","text":"Markdown notes are stored locally and accessible to the build process","impact":"high","confidence":"medium","needs_confirmation":true},{"id":"A2","text":"Tags are indicated using a standard format (e.g., #tag or frontmatter)","impact":"medium","confidence":"low","needs_confirmation":true},{"id":"A3","text":"Backlinks are indicated using wiki-style links (e.g., [[note-name]]) or standard Markdown links","impact":"medium","confidence":"low","needs_confirmation":true},{"id":"A4","text":"The site will be hosted on a static hosting service (e.g., GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel)","impact":"low","confidence":"medium","needs_confirmation":true},{"id":"A5","text":"Search can be implemented client-side using JavaScript","impact":"medium","confidence":"high","needs_confirmation":false}],"open_questions":[{"id":"Q1","text":"What is the current format and structure of the Markdown notes?","impact":"high","blocking":true},{"id":"Q2","text":"How are tags currently indicated in the notes (if at all)?","impact":"high","blocking":true},{"id":"Q3","text":"How are links between notes currently formatted?","impact":"high","blocking":true},{"id":"Q4","text":"What is the approximate volume of notes (number of files, total size)?","impact":"medium","blocking":false},{"id":"Q5","text":"Are there any specific design or styling preferences for the static site?","impact":"low","blocking":false},{"id":"Q6","text":"Should the search support advanced features (fuzzy matching, filters, etc.)?","impact":"medium","blocking":false},{"id":"Q7","text":"Is there a preferred static site generator or should one be recommended?","impact":"medium","blocking":false}],"success_metrics":["SM1: All Markdown notes are successfully converted and accessible on the static site","SM2: Search returns relevant results within 500ms for typical queries","SM3: All tags are extracted and displayed with clickable navigation","SM4: Backlinks are bidirectional and accurately reflect note relationships","SM5: Site builds successfully and deploys to static hosting"],"stakeholders":["User (note author and primary site user)"],"glossary":[{"term":"Static Site","definition":"A website consisting of fixed HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files that do not require server-side processing"},{"term":"Backlinks","definition":"Bidirectional references between notes showing which notes link to a given note"},{"term":"Tags","definition":"Keywords or labels used to categorize and organize notes"},{"term":"Markdown","definition":"A lightweight markup language with plain text formatting syntax"}]}

{"brief":"Turn my Markdown notes into a searchable static site with tags and backlinks.\n","problem_statement":"Markdown notes are currently difficult to browse and discover because they lack fast full-text search, tag-based navigation, and automatic backlink discovery between notes. A static site is needed to publish the notes with these navigation aids while keeping maintenance and hosting simple.","goals":["Convert a collection of Markdown notes into a static HTML site.","Provide client-side full-text search across all notes.","Support tags and generate tag index pages and per-tag listing pages.","Support backlinks by detecting links between notes and showing inbound links on each note page.","Produce a repeatable build process so the site can be regenerated as notes change."],"non_goals":["Building a live, browser-based editor for notes (read-only publishing is sufficient).","User accounts, authentication, or permissions management.","Server-side search, databases, or other required runtime backend services.","Real-time multi-user collaboration features."],"constraints":[{"id":"CNS1","type":"tech","text":"Output must be a static site (no required server-side runtime for core browsing/search/backlinks)."},{"id":"CNS2","type":"tech","text":"Site must include tags and backlinks as first-class navigation features."}],"assumptions":[{"id":"A1","text":"Source notes are primarily standard Markdown files that can be parsed without custom extensions.","impact":"high","confidence":"medium","needs_confirmation":true},{"id":"A2","text":"Tags are represented in a consistent, machine-detectable way (e.g., YAML frontmatter, a defined inline syntax, or a defined convention).","impact":"high","confidence":"low","needs_confirmation":true},{"id":"A3","text":"Backlinks can be derived from a consistent linking convention between notes (e.g., Markdown links or wiki-style links).","impact":"high","confidence":"low","needs_confirmation":true},{"id":"A4","text":"Client-side search using a prebuilt index (generated at build time) is acceptable for the expected corpus size.","impact":"high","confidence":"medium","needs_confirmation":true},{"id":"A5","text":"The desired outcome is primarily for personal use or public read-only consumption, not sensitive-content access control.","impact":"medium","confidence":"medium","needs_confirmation":true},{"id":"A6","text":"The build can be run locally or in CI, and the resulting static assets can be hosted on a static host (e.g., any static web hosting).","impact":"medium","confidence":"medium","needs_confirmation":true}],"open_questions":[{"id":"Q1","text":"Where do the Markdown notes live (local folder, Git repo), and how should updates be ingested (manual build, CI on commit, etc.)?","impact":"high","blocking":true},{"id":"Q2","text":"What tag format should be supported (YAML frontmatter field name(s), inline #tags, both), and are there rules for tag normalization (case, spaces, nesting)?","impact":"high","blocking":true},{"id":"Q3","text":"What link/backlink format should be supported (regular Markdown links, wiki-links like [[Note Title]], relative paths), and how should link resolution work (by filename, title, frontmatter slug)?","impact":"high","blocking":true},{"id":"Q4","text":"Approximately how many notes and total text size are expected (order of magnitude), to size the search index approach and performance targets?","impact":"high","blocking":true},{"id":"Q5","text":"What is the preferred URL scheme and information architecture (mirror folder structure, flat, custom slugs), and should there be an index/home page?","impact":"medium","blocking":false},{"id":"Q6","text":"Should attachments (images, PDFs, other files) be copied and linked, and should they be searchable or just accessible?","impact":"medium","blocking":false},{"id":"Q7","text":"Is a visual graph view of backlinks desired, or is a simple 'Backlinks' list per page sufficient?","impact":"medium","blocking":false},{"id":"Q8","text":"Any theming/branding requirements (minimal, dark mode, typography), and do you need custom navigation elements beyond tags/search/backlinks?","impact":"low","blocking":false},{"id":"Q9","text":"What hosting/deployment target is intended (GitHub Pages, Netlify, local-only), and are there any constraints on using third-party JS libraries for search?","impact":"medium","blocking":false}],"success_metrics":["SM1: Build produces a static site where 100% of discovered Markdown notes are rendered into HTML pages (verified by counting input notes vs output pages, excluding intentionally ignored files).","SM2: Tag navigation works: for every detected tag, a tag page is generated and lists all notes containing that tag (verified by sampling tags and cross-checking membership).","SM3: Backlinks work: for any note that is linked by at least one other note, the note page displays an inbound-links section listing those referring notes (verified by a small test set with known links).","SM4: Full-text search works offline in the browser: given a user-provided set of at least 10 representative queries, the expected target note appears within the top 5 results for at least 9/10 queries (acceptance test).","SM5: Regeneration is repeatable: after changing/adding a note, a rerun of the build updates the site so the new/edited content is present and searchable (verified by a change-and-rebuild test)."],"stakeholders":["Primary user/notes owner","Readers of the published notes (if shared)"],"glossary":[{"term":"Static site","definition":"A website consisting of pre-generated files (HTML/CSS/JS) that can be hosted without server-side code or a database."},{"term":"Tags","definition":"Keywords associated with notes to enable grouping and browsing via tag index pages."},{"term":"Backlinks","definition":"Automatically derived inbound references to a note from other notes, typically displayed as a list of pages that link to the current page."},{"term":"Full-text search","definition":"Search capability that matches query text against the contents of all notes, typically implemented via a build-time index and client-side querying."}]}
